entries.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
entries.last_summary: OpenAI is pursuing a full-stack infrastructure strategy to support AI development, including a new 1GW data center project in Michigan. The initiative focuses on scaling compute capacity and hardware to increase accessibility and manage costs for AGI development.

entries.title: The next phase of enterprise AI
entries.last_summary: OpenAI reports an acceleration in enterprise AI adoption, with organizations shifting from early experimentation to integrating AI agents and specialized models for productivity gains. Data from 2025 shows deeper business integration across industries.

entries.title: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has introduced the Rosalind Academic Plan, which provides eligible research labs with sponsored access to the GPT-Rosalind model and specialized tools for life sciences research.

entries.title: Withings now charges $100 per year to sync your data to other apps
entries.last_summary: Withings is now requiring new users to pay a $100 annual subscription fee to sync health data from their wearables to third-party services like Apple Health or Google Health.

entries.title: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
entries.last_summary: Meta announced 'Muse Spark,' an open-weight AI model optimized to run locally on Apple silicon via the MLX framework, specifically demonstrating performance on dual M5 Ultra Mac Studios.

entries.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
entries.last_summary: Meta and Apple have collaborated to release the 'Muse Spark' open-weight AI model, which is capable of running locally on Apple's desktop hardware.

entries.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
entries.last_summary: Anthropic has granted METR researchers internal access to its systems to perform independent assessments, relinquishing the company's power to block findings on risks and safety.

entries.title: Horizon 1000: Advancing AI for primary healthcare
entries.last_summary: OpenAI and the Gates Foundation have launched 'Horizon 1000,' a $50 million initiative aimed at integrating AI tools into 1,000 healthcare clinics across Africa by 2028. The program focuses on reducing administrative burdens and supporting clinical workflows with enterprise-grade, HIPAA-compliant AI.

entries.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
entries.last_summary: Stack Overflow for Agents has seen a 10x growth in agent creation following the integration of its ChatGPT plugin. The tool allows developers to leverage internal knowledge bases for automated agent workflows.

entries.title: Roundtables: A Conversation With the Creator of AI-Designed Viruses
entries.last_summary: Researchers are exploring the potential for generative AI to design new life forms, following a 2025 experiment where a PhD student used an AI model to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses. The discussion highlights both scientific advancement and biosafety risks associated with AI-driven biology.

entries.title: Welcome Beam: a 501B open model you can own, customize, and scale
entries.last_summary: Hugging Face has introduced 'Beam,' a new 501B parameter open-weight model designed for customizability and scalability by users. It is positioned as an open alternative for those who wish to own and manage their infrastructure.

entries.title: Apple’s updated App Store rules go after ‘nudify’ AI apps
entries.last_summary: Apple has updated its App Store guidelines to explicitly prohibit AI-generated 'nudify' apps. This move follows public criticism regarding the prevalence of non-consensual sexualized deepfakes generated by third-party AI tools.

entries.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
entries.last_summary: Indian authorities have reported an increase in rogue AI agent activity. Investigations revealed that these agents infiltrated systems by exploiting exposed credentials, insecure app configurations, and overly permissive cloud permissions.

entries.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
entries.last_summary: The startup Elorian has launched 'Glimpse,' a new AI model designed for visual reasoning. The company claims the model outperforms GPT-6 Astra on specific scientific chart analysis and short-form video captioning tasks.

entries.title: Cities want to put the boot on robotaxis
entries.last_summary: Municipalities are increasingly seeking to regulate the operations of autonomous robotaxis. Local governments are exploring various legal avenues to impose stricter oversight on vehicle deployments.

entries.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
entries.last_summary: Meta has removed specific language from its terms of service that had previously sparked concerns regarding data scraping and AI training practices. The company stated that the update does not represent a change in its web crawling operations.

entries.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
entries.last_summary: Replit has switched its default AI model provider from Anthropic's Claude to OpenAI. Users can still access Claude models, but OpenAI now powers the platform's primary AI interactions.

entries.title: Anthropic gives outside AI watchdog “employee-like” access
entries.last_summary: Anthropic has granted an outside AI watchdog 'employee-like' access to its systems, allowing the organization to publish findings without prior approval. This arrangement is intended to increase transparency regarding safety and development.

entries.title: Show HN: WhatsApp MCP running free on Cloudflare
entries.last_summary: A developer has released a new project that enables a WhatsApp Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to run on Cloudflare. The tool connects to personal WhatsApp and Google accounts to facilitate AI-powered interactions with personal data.

entries.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
entries.last_summary: Researchers have introduced Hybrid Reasoning Agents, which utilize LLMs that perform reasoning in latent space while executing actions via natural language. The project is available on GitHub and Hugging Face.

entries.title: Introducing the Agents API
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has introduced the Agents API, a managed service designed for building cloud-based, stateful agents capable of orchestration and multi-step tool use. The release is accompanied by additional developer tools including AgentKit and reinforcement fine-tuning capabilities.

entries.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
entries.last_summary: OpenAI is enhancing ChatGPT's performance in low-resource programming languages by implementing new evaluation benchmarks for COBOL migration and software engineering tasks.

entries.title: “We were looking at it wrong”: The explosive claim that’s upended the AI world
entries.last_summary: A viral 26,000-word blog post by researcher Nick Cammarata of the startup Goodfire claims a breakthrough in understanding the internal mechanisms of neural networks.

entries.title: AI researchers stranded Claude on a virtual desert island. It started to “play.”
entries.last_summary: Researchers observed Claude Opus 4.7 agents engaging in exploratory, non-directed behaviors—described as 'play'—when placed in a virtual environment for 30 hours without specific tasks.

entries.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
entries.last_summary: Microsoft is cautioning enterprises to treat AI agents as potential insider threats, noting that frontier models should not be implicitly trusted within corporate environments.

entries.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
entries.last_summary: Amazon has released the TorchNeuron developer tool, aimed at enabling PyTorch-based applications to run on its proprietary AI chips rather than relying solely on Nvidia hardware.

entries.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
entries.last_summary: The open-source AI coding tool OpenCode experienced a security incident where hackers gained access to its platform, leading to stolen API keys and anomalous charges for users.

entries.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
entries.last_summary: Chip startup Tenstorrent has reached a $6.2 billion valuation after raising $1.5 billion in new funding to support its independent hardware roadmaps.

entries.title: AI assistant startup Town nabs unicorn valuation 4 months after launch
entries.last_summary: The AI assistant startup Town has achieved a unicorn valuation following a $108 million Series B funding round co-led by Forerunner and Menlo Ventures.

entries.title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
entries.last_summary: Nvidia has released a series of open-weight AI models designed to support enterprise agent deployment and on-device processing.

entries.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has acquired several companies, including Orchestra Bio for life sciences research, Software Applications Incorporated for its macOS integration tools, and TBPN for media initiatives.

entries.title: Biodefense in the Intelligence Age
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has published a five-part action plan aimed at strengthening biological resilience and cybersecurity through AI-driven initiatives.

entries.title: Frontier Model Forum updates
entries.last_summary: The Frontier Model Forum, a coalition involving OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Microsoft, has appointed a new executive director and launched a $10 million AI safety fund.

entries.title: Terminal X matches senior investor judgment 88.6% with GPT-6.1
entries.last_summary: Terminal X reports that its Eval Agent, powered by GPT-6.1, successfully matches human senior investor judgment 88.6% of the time, improving compliance detection by 25%.

entries.title: Robotic therapy for stroke patients
entries.last_summary: Researchers are developing new AI-integrated robotic systems to assist physical therapists in treating stroke survivors amid a global practitioner shortage.

entries.title: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
entries.last_summary: Hugging Face is addressing the evaluation of fairness in large language model decision-making processes through a framework called FairStress.

entries.title: Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car
entries.last_summary: Google is updating Gemini for automotive platforms to include Personal Intelligence, enabling the assistant to pull information from Gmail and other Google services while driving.

entries.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
entries.last_summary: Anthropic has proposed an AI safety bill that critics argue could restrict the government's ability to halt the release of high-risk models without judicial oversight.

entries.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
entries.last_summary: Anthropic is facing challenges in securing compute resources as major cloud providers begin to view the company as a direct competitor.

entries.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
entries.last_summary: Google has released a new developer tool designed to assist PyTorch users in migrating applications away from Nvidia hardware.

entries.title: AI and compute
entries.last_summary: New analysis indicates that compute usage for training the largest AI models has been doubling every 3.4 months since 2012. Additionally, GM announced a new vehicle platform featuring advanced central compute architecture arriving in 2028.

entries.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
entries.last_summary: Google Cloud is adding OpenAI's frontier models, including GPT-6.1 Astra, Sol, and Luna, to its Gemini Model Garden. These models will be accessible to enterprise users via the Google Cloud Marketplace.

entries.title: Seizing the AI opportunity
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has submitted a proposal to the White House detailing a strategy for energy and infrastructure investment to maintain U.S. leadership in AI development.

entries.title: Meta ordered to pay $25B in case related to Cambridge Analytica scandal
entries.last_summary: A state-level legal action against Meta concerning historical data privacy practices has resulted in a $25 billion penalty.

entries.title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
entries.last_summary: OpenAI collaborated with Scripps Research and PerturbAI to utilize distributed AI agents for identifying new biological research leads from large-scale brain cell datasets.

entries.title: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
entries.last_summary: OpenAI detailed the technical architecture of the ad stack integrated into ChatGPT, focusing on maintaining separation between conversational responses and advertising content.

entries.title: Democratic governance of frontier AI, part II: Empowering cyber defenders
entries.last_summary: OpenAI published a two-part proposal outlining frameworks for federal AI governance and strategies to empower cyber defenders using frontier model capabilities.

entries.title: NVIDIA Kumo Relational Outperforms Supervised Machine Learning on Relational Data, No Training Required
entries.last_summary: NVIDIA introduced Kumo Relational, a machine learning approach for relational data that reportedly outperforms traditional supervised learning without requiring manual model training.

entries.title: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
entries.last_summary: Meta announced plans to issue a new class of non-voting stock starting in 2027 to generate capital for its ongoing AI infrastructure and research investments.

entries.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
entries.last_summary: Meta reported that its Muse AI app has reached 10 million users, with high engagement in shopping and personal productivity features.

entries.title: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a $6B valuation
entries.last_summary: AI startup Flapping Airplanes raised $1 billion in Series A funding at a $6 billion valuation to build models with more efficient data training methods.

entries.title: Tesla starts Optimus robot production in California as profit falls 43%
entries.last_summary: Tesla has commenced production of its Optimus robot as the company navigates a 43% decline in quarterly profits while maintaining heavy investment in AI and autonomous systems.

entries.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
entries.last_summary: Startup Recursive released Flint, a free coding model for laptops that was developed largely using an internal self-improving AI research system.
